statement: The chosen angle pair and exact relative-Y bin identify a certified full source rectangle. The conditional compact X threshold places each cog-pair difference inside that rectangle. Every original rounded source face clause has a named edge holding over the entire rectangle by exact corner checks. Set each removed source plane flag to its actual truth value; all original face ORs hold while retained constraints are unchanged. Some source points can fail the compact threshold, so a compact negative is narrower than a full source negative.
